$comment: Session policy and recovery cases (spec 022, REQ-SEC-005, REQ-SEC-015, ADR-0039) shared by Rust (crates/rust-core/tests/session_fixtures.rs), UniFFI (crates/tran-uniffi/tests/session_fixtures.rs), TypeScript (packages/core-ts/tests/session.test.ts), iOS and Android parity tests. `policy`: lifetimes in seconds and token size in bytes. `recovery`: what a client does after an auth failure. `refreshResponses`: how the answer to `POST /api/auth/refresh` becomes a recovery event; `status: null` means no HTTP answer at all (offline, timeout), `event: null` means the refresh succeeded.

recovery.name: 401 with a refresh credential, first time: refresh once
401 again after the refresh and retry: sign out
401 without a refresh credential: sign out
401 without a refresh credential after a retry: sign out
the refresh was rejected: the credential is dead
the refresh failed some other way: keep the session
